description: The bar chart illustrates the "Recall@10" metric across four different categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, with labels angled slightly upwards, ordered from left to right as a solid grey rectangular block, "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The vertical axis represents the metric values on a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal gridlines at intervals of 0.1. The chart features four vertical bars that are not sorted by height. The first bar, corresponding to the grey rectangular block label, is visually emphasized in orange and is the tallest in the chart, reaching an approximate value of 0.35. The remaining three bars are colored blue. The "- critiquing" bar has an approximate value of 0.29, the "- scoring" bar is the shortest at roughly 0.17, and the "- ranking" bar has a value of approximately 0.23.
